description:
Returns details for one Berlin borough (Bezirk) by ID, optionally with all its districts.

Parameters:
- bezirk_id (required): 2-digit ID ("01" to "12")
- ortsteile: "true" to include all districts of the borough

Key response fields: { bezirk_id, bezirk_name, ortsteile?: [...] } (ortsteile = districts)

Example: bezirk_id="03" → Pankow with 13 districts (Prenzlauer Berg, Weißensee, etc.)
name: berlin_borough_details
title: Borough Details
